svg.aria-label: The claim that the Eiffel Tower is 330 metres tall is checked against three sources; two agree and an older figure of 324 metres is explained by the 2022 antenna.
svg.title: The claim that the Eiffel Tower is 330 metres tall is checked against three sources; two agree and an older figure of 324 metres is explained by the 2022 antenna.
